headline: Rapid Support Forces drone attacks k!ll 19 people in Sudan Blue Nile state

caption:
A brutal escalation in Sudan leaves families de@d and infrastructure in ruins. 🚨

Rights group Emergency Lawyers reported that drones also targeted a big dam in Roseires as part of the escalating civil war.
